episodes.title: Some Dark God Wakes
episodes.summary: A Fae, Vignette Stonemoss, takes refuge on a ship delivering her people from Tirnanoc to The Burgue and is taken in by Spurnroses. Inspector Rycroft "Philo" Philostrate tries to solve a series of murders among the Fae in The Burgue and discovers that there's more to the case than he ever believed possible.

episodes.title: Aisling
episodes.summary: Piety brings in a fae witch to help find the missing Jonah. Vignette meets some new friends after fleeing the Spurnrose house when Ezra directs his attentions to her. Philo makes the acquaintance of a unique puppeteer while investigating the gruesome death of a fae singer.

episodes.title: Kingdoms of the Moon
episodes.summary: In the past, Philo and his men set up at a fae mimasery. He meets Vignette and the two soon fall in love... but circumstances drive them apart.

episodes.title: The Joining of Unlike Things
episodes.summary: The killer takes another victim: a headmaster from Philo's foundling home. The Black Ravens realize that a mole is in their midst and suspect Vignette, Alistair confronts Ritter about Jonah's abduction, and Philo chooses which world he belongs in.

episodes.title: Grieve No More
episodes.summary: Philo tries to find the connection between the two victims, and Imogen invites Agreus to tea. Vignette begins her new job as a lot runner, and Sophie arrives in Parliament to take her dead father's place.

episodes.title: Unaccompanied Fae
episodes.summary: Philo discovers who Querelle's benefactor was, but his confession to Portia puts his career at risk. Vignette visits the museum to see an exhibition on Tirnanoc, and Agreus and Imogen attend a charity event together.

episodes.title: The World to Come
episodes.summary: Portia recants her testimony against Philo, but Philo refuses to recant his half-blood nature. Imogen and Agreus grow closer, and Jonah gets a new tutor after an assignation with Sophie.

episodes.title: The Gloaming
episodes.summary: Philo meets his father and learns how the man met his mother. The darkasher strikes again, but Philo learns who its controller is. Imogen and Agreus have another assignation, and Jonah confronts ABsalom about his parentage.

episodes.title: Fight or Flight
episodes.summary: Lovers Philo and Vignette risk their lives to help the oppressed Faefolk of Carnival Row.

episodes.title: New Dawn
episodes.summary: When Philo plots to challenge Jonah's hereditary claim to the Chancellorship, Vignette intervenes.

episodes.title: The Martyr's Hand
episodes.summary: While Philo investigates the murders of the Black Raven's leaders, Vignette plots revenge.

episodes.title: An Unkindness of Ravens
episodes.summary: Philo races to stop Vignette's revenge before the Black Raven spark even worse violence.

episodes.title: Reckoning
episodes.summary: Philo plots Vignette's rescue with an unlikely ally. Jonah discovers Sophie's treachery. The murderer strikes again.

episodes.title: Original Sins
episodes.summary: A painful truth haunts Philo as Carnival Row faces reprisals for the horrific events at Bleakness Keep.

episodes.title: Kindred
episodes.summary: Torn between his Human and Fae sides, Philo makes a choice.

episodes.title: Facta Non Verba
episodes.summary: Reeling from the consequences of his choices, Philo rejects defining himself as either Human or Fae.

episodes.title: Battle Lines
episodes.summary: Justice later through peace, or now through blood?
